instruction: In the LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet, select the header row (row 1, cells B1 to E1) and apply bold formatting to these cells. Save the file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying bold formatting to header cells B1 to E1. Evaluator checks if cell B1 has bold font applied (representative check - if B1 is bold, the range operation was successful). Original headers: MCC 150072, MCC 150006, MCC 150063, MCC 150066.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL COVERAGE GAP: Instruction requires bold formatting for cells B1 to E1 (4 cells), but evaluator only checks cell B1
Representative check assumption is flawed - bold formatting can be applied to individual cells independently, so checking only B1 does not guarantee B1:E1 are all bold
Task could be partially completed (e.g., only B1 formatted, C1/D1/E1 not formatted) and still incorrectly pass verification
Evaluator logic (getter + metric) is individually correct but semantically incomplete for verifying the full instruction requirements
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Check all 4 cells (B1, C1, D1, E1) individually and require all to be bold for full credit
Implement partial credit scoring: 0.25 per cell (B1, C1, D1, E1) that is bold
Alternative: Use a range-based getter that can check font properties for multiple cells at once
